findings.evidence: Functoriality.lean:8 `public import Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting`; Functoriality.lean:56-86 declared before `variable [TopologicalSpace X]` at :88; Deck/Fiber/Transport.lean:52 `@[expose] def fiberMap (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (b : B)`; Deck/Fiber/Transport.lean:8-9 imports.
findings.fix: Keep the `ContinuousMap` namespace but move the four declarations to an earlier general file (e.g. a new `TauCeti/Topology/FiberMap.lean` importing only `Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Basic`), and have `Monodromy/Functoriality.lean` import it; the monodromy statements (`IsCoveringMap.fiberMap_monodromy`, `monodromyNatTrans`, …) stay put.
findings.issue: `ContinuousMap.fiberMap` and its lemmas `fiberMap_apply_coe` (:66), `fiberMap_id_apply` (:73), `fiberMap_comp_apply` (:79) are now root `ContinuousMap` API with no covering or monodromy content — they are declared above `variable [TopologicalSpace X]` (:88), so they need no topology on the base — yet they live in "Functoriality of covering-space monodromy", whose only import is `Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting`. The repo already has a lower-level near-twin, `TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap` (`Deck/Fiber/Transport.lean:52`), whose import chain (`Deck.Conjugation` → `Deck.Basic` → `Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Lemmas`) never reaches homotopy lifting and so cannot use the rooted definition.

findings.evidence: Functoriality.lean:207-231, incl. docstring "No covering hypothesis is used" and three `omit [TopologicalSpace E]` markers; the proof body is `Set.equivOfEq <| Set.ext …`.
findings.fix: Move these three to the same earlier general file (alongside `ContinuousMap.fiberMap`, importing only `Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs`); leave `IsCoveringMap.compFiberEquiv_monodromy` and `monodromyHomeomorphCompNatIso` here, since they do use monodromy.
findings.issue: Same problem for `Homeomorph.compFiberEquiv` and its lemmas `compFiberEquiv_apply_coe` (:219) and `compFiberEquiv_symm_apply_coe` (:228): purely set-level fibre relabelling `(h ∘ p) ⁻¹' {y} ≃ p ⁻¹' {h.symm y}`, marked `omit [TopologicalSpace E]` and documented as using no covering hypothesis, but placed in the covering-monodromy file and hence gated behind `Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting`.

summary: The move of `IsCoveringMap.isOpenQuotientMap` into `Topology/Covering/Quotient.lean` is well placed and its new import is genuine. But rooting `fiberMap` into `ContinuousMap` and `homeomorphCompFiberEquiv` into `Homeomorph` turns seven declarations into generic, covering-free API that is still stranded in a covering-monodromy file behind `Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Lifting`.
